From c79484f68b164a4b59c85b7a5008455ddd7af6fb Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: YueHaibing <yuehaibing@huawei.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Apr 2020 15:13:37 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] drm/mediatek: Fix Kconfig warning

WARNING: unmet direct dependencies detected for MTK_MMSYS
  Depends on [n]: (ARCH_MEDIATEK [=y] || COMPILE_TEST [=n]) && COMMON_CLK_MT8173_MMSYS [=n]
  Selected by [y]:
  - DRM_MEDIATEK [=y] && HAS_IOMEM [=y] && DRM [=y] && (ARCH_MEDIATEK [=y] || ARM && COMPILE_TEST [=n]) && COMMON_CLK [=y] && HAVE_ARM_SMCCC [=y] && OF [=y]

Make DRM_MEDIATEK depend on MTK_MMSYS to fix this.

Fixes: 2c758e301ed9 ("soc / drm: mediatek: Move routing control to mmsys device")
Signed-off-by: YueHaibing <yuehaibing@huawei.com>
Reviewed-by: Enric Balletbo i Serra <enric.balletbo@collabora.com>
Signed-off-by: Chun-Kuang Hu <chunkuang.hu@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/mediatek/Kconfig b/drivers/gpu/drm/mediatek/Kconfig
index c420f5a3d33b..aa74aac3cbcc 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/mediatek/Kconfig
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/mediatek/Kconfig
@@ -6,12 +6,12 @@ config DRM_MEDIATEK
 	depends on COMMON_CLK
 	depends on HAVE_ARM_SMCCC
 	depends on OF
+	depends on MTK_MMSYS
 	select DRM_GEM_CMA_HELPER
 	select DRM_KMS_HELPER
 	select DRM_MIPI_DSI
 	select DRM_PANEL
 	select MEMORY
-	select MTK_MMSYS
 	select MTK_SMI
 	select VIDEOMODE_HELPERS
 	help
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/mediatek/Kconfig`**
   - The line `select MTK_MMSYS` has been removed.
   - A new line `depends on MTK_MMSYS` has been added.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification establishes a dependency relationship where `DRM_MEDIATEK` now explicitly depends on `MTK_MMSYS` instead of selecting it. This change addresses a Kconfig warning regarding unmet direct dependencies, ensuring that the configuration is correctly set up to avoid potential issues during compilation. The fix is related to a previous commit that moved routing control to the mmsys device, indicating that the dependency is necessary for proper functionality.

Here is the commit message:
drm/mediatek: Fix Kconfig warning

WARNING: unmet direct dependencies detected for MTK_MMSYS
  Depends on [n]: (ARCH_MEDIATEK [=y] || COMPILE_TEST [=n]) && COMMON_CLK_MT8173_MMSYS [=n]
  Selected by [y]:
  - DRM_MEDIATEK [=y] && HAS_IOMEM [=y] && DRM [=y] && (ARCH_MEDIATEK [=y] || ARM && COMPILE_TEST [=n]) && COMMON_CLK [=y] && HAVE_ARM_SMCCC [=y] && OF [=y]

Make DRM_MEDIATEK depend on MTK_MMSYS to fix this.

Fixes: 2c758e301ed9 ("soc / drm: mediatek: Move routing control to mmsys device")
Signed-off-by: YueHaibing <yuehaibing@huawei.com>
Reviewed-by: Enric Balletbo i Serra <enric.balletbo@collabora.com>
Signed-off-by: Chun-Kuang Hu <chunkuang.hu@kernel.org>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by an unmet direct dependency for the `MTK_MMSYS` configuration option, which was not properly enforced in the Kconfig file. The `DRM_MEDIATEK` option was incorrectly set to select `MTK_MMSYS`, leading to potential compilation issues when the necessary conditions for `MTK_MMSYS` were not met. This could result in the driver not functioning correctly or failing to compile in certain configurations.

Here is the patch:
 	depends on HAVE_ARM_SMCCC
 	depends on OF
+	depends on MTK_MMSYS
 	select DRM_GEM_CMA_HELPER
 	select DRM_KMS_HELPER
 	select DRM_PANEL
 	select MEMORY
-	select MTK_MMSYS
 	select MTK_SMI
 	select VIDEOMODE_HELPERS

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```plaintext
- select MTK_MMSYS
```
Reason:
The `DRM_MEDIATEK` option incorrectly used `select` for `MTK_MMSYS`, which does not enforce the necessary conditions for `MTK_MMSYS` to be satisfied. This can lead to situations where `MTK_MMSYS` is selected without meeting its dependencies, causing potential compilation issues or driver malfunctions.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```plaintext
+ depends on MTK_MMSYS
```
Reason:
By changing `select MTK_MMSYS` to `depends on MTK_MMSYS`, the configuration now properly enforces that `MTK_MMSYS` must be satisfied before `DRM_MEDIATEK` can be enabled. This ensures that all necessary conditions for `MTK_MMSYS` are met, preventing compilation issues and ensuring the driver functions correctly.
